lucy.label: Lucy
lucy.about: Make a mix by describing it in a conversation.

lucy.proposals.label: Lucy's proposals
lucy.proposals.about: Lucy proposes a mix with rules you can see, edit, compare and restore.

lucy.commit.label: Saving Lucy's mixes
lucy.commit.about: Approving a proposal into the current mix or a draft.

lucy.memory.label: Lucy's memory
lucy.memory.about: What Lucy remembers between conversations, which you can see, edit and clear.

lucy.voice.label: Voice input
lucy.voice.about: Talking to Lucy instead of typing.

lucy.remote_providers.label: AI services for Lucy
lucy.remote_providers.about: Planning with Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible host instead of the built-in planner.

lucy.listening_history.label: Listening history for Lucy
lucy.listening_history.about: What you play is noted so Lucy can know your most-played songs.

lucy.cloud_conversation.label: Lucy's conversation in Cloud
lucy.cloud_conversation.about: Talk to Lucy in the browser about your library and mixes; she proposes changes you can save.

lucy.usage_windows.label: Lucy's allowance on a session and a week
lucy.usage_windows.about: Measures Lucy by what each message costs, on a five-hour session and a weekly limit, in place of turns a month (ADR-0481 to ADR-0484). The build ships on so a rule can grant it, and with no matching rule it is off.
lucy.usage_windows.cloud_surface_reason: The session and week meters and their pages are not built yet (ADR-0484)

lucy.extra_usage.label: Extra Lucy usage in prepaid packs
lucy.extra_usage.about: Buy a prepaid pack of extra Lucy usage, spent only once the weekly limit is reached (ADR-0486). The build ships on so a rule can grant it, and with no matching rule it is off.
lucy.extra_usage.cloud_surface_reason: The pages for buying and seeing extra usage are not built yet (ADR-0486)

lucy.usage_shadow.label: Measure Lucy's new allowance in the background
lucy.usage_shadow.about: Records what each Lucy turn would use under the new allowance without changing anything a member sees. Turning it off stops that recording at once.
lucy.usage_shadow.cloud_surface_reason: A background measurement of each turn; nothing on a Cloud screen changes
